name: mindmap-prompt
description: Drop ideas on a canvas, connect them, and compile the map into an organized Markdown prompt. Offline and dependency-free: a self-contained page for capture, a deterministic compiler for the map -> prompt step, and JSON Canvas (.canvas) as the save format so a map can be reworked later or opened in Obsidian. A ✦ control hands any node to `claude -p` in your repo to expand it into sub-ideas or sharpen its wording, previewed before it lands.

interface.longDescription: Drop ideas on a canvas, connect them, and compile the map into an organized Markdown prompt. Offline and dependency-free: a self-contained page for capture, a deterministic compiler for the map -> prompt step, and JSON Canvas (.canvas) as the save format so a map can be reworked later or opened in Obsidian. A ✦ control hands any node to `claude -p` in your repo to expand it into sub-ideas or sharpen its wording, previewed before it lands. Spawns parallel subagents. On Codex this needs `multi_agent = true` in `~/.codex/config.toml`; the skill's references/codex-tools.md maps the tool names.
